question: The photograph in the Whitney Museum of American Art's collection with accession number 2022.128 shows a person holding a book. Which military unit did the author of this book join in 1813? Answer without using articles.

mistake_reason: FileSurfer produced a malformed structured output: it wrapped the JSON in conversational text, used single quotes instead of double quotes, and omitted the closing brace. This FM-4.4 formatting error prevented automated parsing of key fields. As a result, the team relied on salvaged strings and external guesswork, misattributing the book and author and concluding the wrong unit (Lützow Free Corps) instead of the ground truth (Russian-German Legion).
